Failures remain a mix of easy mistakes (not enumerating alternatives) and hard ones (attention/compliance limits during extended search). optimization_velocity.recommendation: Emerging evidence that format matters as much as content. Short absolute imperatives (056f0a9e style) work; multi-step threshold procedures (c67e6085 style) don't. Future mutations should consider: (1) distilling key rules into brief imperatives, (2) testing whether 0126ca3e's pre-search enumeration works, (3) reformatting c67e6085 as shorter imperative before considering removal, (4) continued task sampling for coverage breadth.
